shellCommands.command: ls -la && git status --short && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.jsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.html" -o -name "*.css" \) -print | grep -v node_modules | head -100

cat src/App.tsx; echo ----; cat src/main.tsx; echo ----; cat index.html; echo ----; cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; echo ----; cat AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

grep -n -i "charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30; echo ----; awk '/## Charts|## .*@gravity-ui\/charts/{f=1} f{print; n++} n>40{exit}' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/ | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{for(const v of JSON.parse(s).slice(-40))console.log(v)})'); do echo -n "$v  "; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n' | grep -o '"@gravity-ui/uikit": *"[^"]*"' ; echo; done 2>/dev/null | tail -45

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -15; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; grep -A4 '"dependencies"' package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && wc -l INDEX.md; ls guides; echo ----; rg -n -i "theme" INDEX.md | head -40; echo ----; cat guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | head -150
sed -n 1,125p INDEX.md | head -125 | cut -c1-220; echo ----COLORS; cat guides/colors.md | head -80; echo ----LINE; ls guides/series-types; cat guides/series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist && ls; D=$(find . -name "index.d.ts" | head -3); echo "$D"; grep -rn "export declare const Chart\b\|declare function Chart\b\|export declare const Chart:" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; echo ----; grep -rln "interface ChartData\b\|type ChartData\b" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm && grep -n "ChartComponent\b" -A6 components/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "export interface ChartData\b" -A40 core/types/index.d.ts | head -60; echo ----LEG; grep -rn "export interface ChartData\|colors?:\|legend?:\|title?:\|xAxis?:\|yAxis?:" core/types/index.d.ts | head -20

grep -rn -i "theme" --include=*.d.ts . | grep -v "^./docs" | head -20; echo ----; grep -rn "g-color-text-primary\|g-color-line-generic\|g-color-base-background" --include=*.js . | head -5 | cut -c1-250; echo; grep -rln "useThemeType\|useThemeValue\|getRootClassName" . | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text 2>&1 | head -20; echo ----; f=$(ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null); echo "$f"; [ -n "$f" ] && sed -n 1,60p "$f"; echo ----AXIS; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | cut -c1-240

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text 2>&1 | head -8; echo ----; rg -n -C 3 "categor" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -60 | cut -c1-220; echo ----; grep -rn "categories" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types && grep -rn "export interface ChartLegend\b\|export interface ChartTitle\b" -A12 . | grep -v "^\s*\*" | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; cat .gitignore; echo ----; git status --short; echo ----; git diff --stat; grep -n "charts\|uikit" package.json
